tagline: Your own online store, with an AI shop assistant.

steps.text: This is ShopFlow: your own online store, with an AI shop assistant. Let's follow one order, from your customer's phone to your dashboard.
steps.say: This is Shop Flow. Your own online store, with an AI shop assistant. Let's follow one order, from your customer's phone, to your dashboard.

steps.title: Your store, your link
steps.text: Your customers open your store link, browse by category, and see what's in stock right now.

steps.title: Ask the AI shop assistant
steps.text: Not sure what to buy? They ask the AI shop assistant. It checks your real stock before it answers.

steps.title: The AI prepares the cart
steps.text: It prepares the cart for them. One tap, and the item is in.

steps.title: Simple checkout
steps.text: At checkout, they choose delivery, cash on delivery or store pickup, and enter their address.

steps.title: Pay by GCash or bank
steps.text: The order page shows how to pay by GCash or bank transfer, with a reference number.
steps.say: The order page shows how to pay, by G Cash or bank transfer, with a reference number.

steps.title: Upload the payment screenshot
steps.text: They upload their payment screenshot right here. No more digging through chats.

steps.title: Check the payment
steps.text: On your side, the order waits under Check payment. Compare the screenshot, then tap Payment received.

steps.title: Your AI store co-pilot
steps.text: Or just ask your store co-pilot: mark this order as packed. It prepares the change, and nothing happens until you tap Confirm.
steps.say: Or just ask your store co-pilot. Mark this order as packed. It prepares the change, and nothing happens until you tap, Confirm.

steps.title: Ship it
steps.text: Add the courier and tracking number, then tap Ship.

steps.title: Your customer stays updated
steps.text: Your customer sees every step on their order page, with the tracking number. No need to message you.
